en: The image shows a vintage, colorized street scene with several ornate European-style buildings surrounding a public square. The architecture features classical facades, and there are a few people and a horse-drawn carriage visible. Trees, street lamps, and tram rails are present. The upper left corner of the postcard has the text 'Hirschberg, Warmbrunner Platz.'
